ja112:1.1: By way of barley meal and by gruel,
ja112:1.2: And the flowering of the two-fold leaf,
ja112:1.3: With (the hand) I give, by that I do speak,
ja112:1.4: With (the hand) I don’t give, by that I don’t speak,
ja112:1.5: This is the path to the Barley Market,
ja112:1.6: This is the secret path that you must know.
